text.title: GraphQL API Design Procedure
text.summary: 8-step procedure applying the graphql-api-design methodology end-to-end. Each step lists inputs, action, output, and optional decision gate.

step.name: model-aggregates-and-types
step.action: Map each aggregate to a type using singular nouns (User, Order). Add the Node interface wherever federation or polymorphism applies.

step.name: design-sdl
step.input: Type list + client query mock list
step.action: Write SDL: types, interfaces (Node, Timestamped), Relay connections, payload+errors. For every mutation define <Name>Input and <Name>Payload { entity, userErrors } and document the partial-success cases. Run graphql-schema-linter.
step.decision-gate: Any mutation returning a scalar blocks the step — rule mutation-error-union.

step.name: author-auth-directives
step.action: Define the @auth(scope: ENUM_VALUE) directive (or the equivalent permission class) and apply it to every field and mutation touching auth-scoped data. Record which scope guards which resource.
step.decision-gate: If a scope does not apply uniformly to every field of a type, split the type — one scope per field is the only reviewable shape.

step.name: breaking-change-check
step.action: Run graphql-inspector diff with --fail-on-breaking. If breaking, justify or use @deprecated instead.
step.output: non-breaking diff or justified breaking change
step.decision-gate: Reject if breaking without explicit override.

step.name: scaffold-resolvers
step.action: Generate resolvers + DataLoaders + permission_classes. Loaders live in get_context(), never at module scope.

step.name: apply-limits
step.action: Wire QueryDepthLimiter(max=10) + QueryComplexityExtension(max=200). Tune from histograms post-launch.

step.name: audit-naming
step.action: Walk every type. Verify Connection/Edge/PageInfo on paginated lists, <Name>Input on mutation arguments, <Name>Payload on mutation results, and opaque IDs on every relation.
step.decision-gate: Any deviation blocks — rules naming-conventions-enforced + opaque-ids-for-relations.

step.name: contract-test
step.action: Add a permission audit test (every Mutation/Query field carries a directive or permission_classes) + an N+1 integration test. Run validate-graphql-api-design.py and open the PR with the schema, the auth map and the naming audit.
step.output: Test suite green + approved design spec
